name: my-workbench-lanes
description: MyWorkbench specialist lanes as a packaged DSH agent-preset plugin: one delegation tool per specialist, each starting a child under that lane's own preset (persona + restricted tool set); the route a lane uses can be pinned in <DSH_HOME>/my-workbench-lanes.json. The version names the my-workbench release that rendered the installed copy: `my-workbench --dsh` writes its own version over this field, and the release gate fails if the two differ. The plugin imports only its two generated sibling modules, so it declares no package dependency and works under any supported DSH installation.
